mods.name: Invisible Frames
mods.description:
Lets you turn Item Frames invisible by right-clicking them with a glass pane!
Fully server-side and can be customised with a datapack, read more on the mod website

New in v2.0:
  - Rewritten the mod to support NeoForge and to improve compatability
  - Changed the way item frames are made invisible; you now have to right-click while holding a glass pane instead of left clicking
  - Item frames can now only be made invisible if they are already holding an item. If the item is removed from an invisible item frame, however, it will remain invisible
  - Added more visual feedback when making an item frame invisible
      - Item frames will turn into a transparent white plane and emit particles while fading out when they are made invisible
  - Added a new advancement "Where did it go?" for making an item frame invisible
  - You can now left click while sneaking to make an item frame visible again without popping out the item it is holding
  - Fixed a bug where "fixed" item frames could be made invisible

New in v2.2.1:
  - Updated to 1.21.11

releases.notes:
# New in v2.0:
v2.0 comes with some new features and changes to how you make item frames invisible. The mod has also been rewritten to support NeoForge and to improve compatibility

## Changes
- Changed the way item frames are made invisible; you now have to right-click while holding a glass pane instead of left-clicking
- Item frames can now only be made invisible if they are already holding an item
    - If the item is removed from an invisible item frame, it will remain invisible
- The mod id is now `eg_invisible_frames`. The fabric version supplies the old id (`eg-invisible-frames`) for compatibility, however the new id should be used if possible

## New Features
- Added a new advancement "Where did it go?" for making an item frame invisible
- Added more visual feedback when making an item frame invisible
    - Item frames will turn into a transparent white plane and emit particles while fading out when they are made invisible
- You can now left click while sneaking to make an item frame visible again without popping out the item it is holding

## Fixes
- Fixed a bug where "fixed" item frames could be made invisible
- Fixed a bug where damaging an item frame in creative mode would make it visible but retain the item it was made invisible with, making the item frame unable to be made invisible again

readmeSummary: To make an item frame invisible, make sure there is an item in the frame and right-click it with any glass pane.
